name: AlphaSights
description: Query your expert call transcripts and research from AlphaSights. Search the research library, summarise recent calls and test investment theses in Claude. Individuals need an AlphaSights account to access the connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AlphaSights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AlphaSights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.alphasights.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AlphaSights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AlphaSights provides these MCP tools: find_alphasights_research.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AlphaSights in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
AlphaSights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
